title: NNTP reader: no rate limiting on AUTHINFO attempts
description: reader/session/lifecycle.rs:275-304 and dispatch.rs:48-60: no limit on failed authentication attempts per session. A client can brute-force credentials indefinitely on a single connection with no delay, lockout, or connection close. Fix: add a per-session failure counter; after N failures (e.g., 5), close the connection with 400 or return increasing delays.
